subject: Sentinel QBR: account health triage & exec attention
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sentinel QBR: account health triage & exec attention

Team —

I'm kicking off the QBR triage for our top renewal-risk cohort (see attached register). Goal: produce a concise "signal board" for the execs with three things per account: (1) current health (green/amber/red + 2-sentence rationale), (2) renewal risk (low/med/high + drivers), and (3) specific exec ask (decision/credit/legal/SWAT).

Please do the following by EOD Monday (2028-06-17):
- Owners: update your assigned rows in qbr_sentinel_risk_register.xlsx (attached) with latest health indicators and proposed asks.
- Add any customer-visible evidence (logs, recent incidents, usage delta) as attachments or Drive links.
- Each account should include one succinct exec-level bullet — no more than one line.

Initial list of priority accounts included: Vantage AI (renewal Q3), CloudBridge (partner resale), and two prioritized mid-market accounts. I care most about Vantage — they've shown a 28% token-usage drop and flagged latency regressions on long-chat flows.

I've created a consolidated Drive draft here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1G_Sentinel_QBR_RiskRegister
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/DEAL-98743

Attachments: qbr_sentinel_risk_register.xlsx (master sheet)

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Director, Customer Success (Renewals)
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@vantageai.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sentinel QBR: account health triage & exec attention

Thanks Marcus — filling in Vantage AI row now. Quick summary (will put formal snapshot in Drive and attach a pdf):

Vantage AI — health: AMBER
- Rationale: Daily inference calls down ~28% month-over-month; customers report intermittent latency >2s on long chat threads (60+ turns).
- Renewal risk: HIGH (renewal in Sept). Primary drivers: performance regression after our 2028-05 model swap; increased token costs reported by their procurement team.
- Exec ask: Approval to allocate a one-time credit of $45k and priority Dedicated slot for a 2-week performance stabilization window (exec sponsor: Elena Soto).

Evidence attached: vantage_health_snapshot.pdf (contains token-usage charts and last three incident logs).

Elena — correct me if I missed anything on the ask or timing.

Attachments: vantage_health_snapshot.pdf

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Lead Renewal Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Sentinel QBR: account health triage & exec attention

Solid plan. A couple of technical notes to add to the register for Vantage AI (will paste the short bullets into the sheet):
- Observed KV cache invalidations correlated with the 2028-05 model swap; those appear to increase end-to-end latency for long sessions.
- We have a mitigation: pin model variant with older KV behavior for Vantage for a 2-week canary. Engineering estimate: ~8 hours to enable route + validation.

Suggest adding a short "impact if not addressed" line for execs — e.g., "potential churn risk if latency persists during PO renewal window".

I'll flag the stabilization canary as a tactical ask; the credit ask should be routed through Finance and sales for approval.

On the timeline: I can validate the canary details and provide the runbook by Monday EOD.

Aisha Rahman
Principal Technical Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference

Marcus / team —

I've reviewed the Vantage snapshot and Priya's ask. Drafted the exec-level bullet points below (one-liners suitable for the CRO/CEO):

- Vantage AI — "Performance regression after May model swap caused usage drop and customer incidents; recommend $45k one-time credit + priority Dedicated slot for 2-week stabilization (owner: Priya)."
- CloudBridge (partner) — "Contract renewal contingent on marketplace listing timeline; request sales/partner exec to approve expedited onboarding window."

Open decisions for execs (we should surface exactly these in the QBR deck):
1) Approve the one-time credit for Vantage ($45k) — finance signoff required.
2) Approve immediate priority Dedicated capacity for the stabilization canary (Ops to commit resource).
3) If performance doesn't stabilize within the canary, authorize a short-term uplift program (credits + engineering SWAT).

I'll synthesize these into the consolidated register and create a one-page slide for the QBR deck. Marcus — can you confirm whether you want this presented as a single "asks" slide or split by deal?

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

Decision on format: one slide with per-account asks (keeps execs focused). Laura — please hand me the deck-friendly one-pager and I'll place it in the exec packet.
